_doc: Cases of rsm.bench.regress (development only; nothing here is read by the pipeline). bbox = S,W,N,E, each fixed a priori (rule named in bbox_rule), never from the GPS. seed = an older run whose motion/ and rotation/ are reused. score: gps = Van Gestel track.gpx (scoring only), landmarks = regress_landmarks.json, none = verdict and calibration only. stage / window (T2, docs/CONCEPT_test_strategy.md C): the frozen stage of the case and an optional window [t0, t1) of it in video seconds (--stages); the short cases (rousset-end, pennes-descent, madone-town, gotthard-start) are windows of the stages; a window that does not start at the video start carries a start_bbox (start_bbox_rule), as the app run with a start frame: 10-15 min of road in a 60 km frame are ambiguous without one. pbf: $RSM_OSM_DIR = test-data/osm by default. landmarks: the key in regress_landmarks.json (default the case name).

cases.name: lahntal-marburg
cases.known: no_route: the vms speed is about 3x too low (T1 clip lahntal-uniform-35m42, implied f_eff about 860), the scan finds f_eff 211 (T2 of 2026-11-20)

cases.known: no_route: same footage family as lahntal-marburg, vms scale too low, the scan finds f_eff 193 (T2 of 2026-11-20)
